head: codex/32-runner-policy-preflight
title: [v0.92][CI][runners] Make larger-runner eligibility branch-independent and observable (#32)
body:
## Summary

Adds a focused read-only `csdlc-github runner-preflight` operation that distinguishes larger-runner capacity, runner-group policy, and live dispatchability. It preserves selected-repository scope while requiring branch-independent workflow eligibility, reports stale workflow references without treating authorization uncertainty as absence, and refuses to accept a stale or unrelated canary.

## Proof

- 11 focused runner-preflight classifier/schema tests pass.
- The API/CLI integration test proves paginated runner and repository discovery, JSON stdout, fail-closed exit behavior, and credential redaction.
- Existing GitHub action boundary tests and strict Clippy pass.
- Live terminal canary: run 31236518300, job 93054382571, exact head 3558f41b2395e9cb80f2804ba09f68914e9690ec, expected label and runner group, completed success.
- Exact-head independent review passed with no P0-P3 findings.

Closes #32
